name: Socket
description: Closed cube outline, two large dots, no small breaks.
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE refined variation of this Fabrica Tinker cube-outline logo, specifically for tiny UI rendering. Reference image is for the concept only. Output pure WHITE logo on perfectly solid BLACK #000000 background, flat two-color stencil. No transparency request, no checkerboard, no mockup, no texture, no shadows, no gradients, no typography. Square canvas with centered full logo and 15% margin. Bold precisely geometric hexagonal outer silhouette suggests a cube/socket. No internal cube dividing lines. The interior dots must stay distinct when the whole mark is only 8 pixels tall: huge simple dots, very generous black clearance, moderately bold frame rather than choking it with weight. Make mark almost as wide as tall to maximize interior room. SOCKET: a closed, symmetric hexagonal ring, point at top and bottom, flat vertical sides. Consistent wall thickness around 12 percent of overall width. Two large circular dots side by side, each 20 percent of overall width, their centers separated by 35 percent of overall width. Spacious interior. No opening in frame. Total only three white connected shapes: hexagonal ring and two circles. Elegant friendly precision.
